title: AgentSuite Tool composition manifest
description: The closed, digest-pinned build input for one standalone Tool Sandbox Image.

schemaVersion.description: AgentSuite specification version used by this manifest.

mediaType.description: Media type identifying a Tool composition manifest.

id.description: Exact Tool identifier selected from the suite catalog.

version.description: Exact Tool semantic version selected from the suite catalog.

manifestDigest.description: JCS SHA-256 digest of the selected Tool manifest.

platform.description: Exact platform of the selected bundled Tool variant.

variantDigest.description: Canonical digest selecting one same-platform Tool variant.

buildProfile.description: Suite-local build-profile identifier supplying the runtime base.
